cards.front: How many sides does a pentagon have?
cards.back: 5 sides and 5 angles.

cards.front: Is a tipped square still a quadrilateral?
cards.back: Yes. Turning a shape does not change its sides.

cards.front: How many faces, edges, and vertices does a cube have?
cards.back: 6 faces, 12 edges, 8 vertices.

cards.front: Which is bigger: one half or one fourth of the same pizza?
cards.back: One half. More shares means smaller shares.
Yes. Triangle halves and rectangle halves of the same square are the same size.

cards.front: Cut into 3 parts: are they always thirds?
cards.back: Only if the parts are equal.
